song.name: War of the Ancients
song.plot: Human kings of Eldoria discover the vampires and attempt to purge them. Acheron leads the Covenant in a covert war, defeating the kings and forcing human monarchies into secret subjugation.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "clash of titans / haunting gale" piece. The reworked version anchors it to the canonical covert war: human kings discovering the vampires and trying to purge them, with Acheron leading the Covenant to defeat them and force the monarchies into secret subjugation. "Behind the veil" and "behind the throne" capture the shadow-warfare nature. Preserves the 4-verse structure and 7-8 syllable meter. Suggested song direction: epic, martial, predatory — war drums, brass swells, dark choir, low battle chants.

section.reworked: A war of ancient mortal kings As shadow warfare victory brings Their power unleashed, the kings obey As Acheron demands his sway
